why: 2026-11-12: Golden Lake Acres (13648 11 St NE, Hatton; ND HHS 07.17.2025: GOLDEN LAKE ACRES, owner Dickson, Jacob, 48 units) is a private resort (bar/restaurant, store, beach) with RV spaces, but it has no website (Google lists only facebook.com/goldenlakeacres, which shows nothing without a login), no posted rate anywhere, no booking site, and is on neither RV Life (Algolia park index, nothing within 40 km but city parks) nor Good Sam (directory cache 2026-10-02, nothing within ~30 km). Presence passes (Google: RV park, 4.5 on 160 reviews, 701-963-3011, reviews mostly about the bar and burgers), but the private-park price indicator fails, and as a likely seasonal park it also fails long-stay test 2 (no nightly rate on its own website and no booking site). Steele County's Attractions page (undated) says only 'RV spaces with electricity and sewer, along with space for tents' and 'Come check out the new RV campground!' with no price.
name: Golden Lake Acres
flags: Mostly seasonal by every sign, though no count of nightly vs seasonal sites exists anywhere: Esri imagery (read 2026-11-12, summer capture) shows two dense rows of RVs on the east shore by the store and another packed cluster just north, every pad occupied; the next-door Golden Lake Shores was sold in 2025 on an MLS listing (Crary Real Estate MLS 24-1125, listed 2024-07-03, sold 2025-04-18) as a 30-site full-hookup campground 'fully reserved with a wait list', campers returning each summer. Had a rate turned up, the nightly share would still be unknown and the park would sit on the fence, mostly seasonal: the 'drop' side of AWH's 2026-10-31 rule.

Golden Lake Tenting (Google, 47.5625697,-97.6408799, 4.4 on 18 reviews, 218-779-4652, links to the same Golden Lake Acres Facebook page) is ~1 km SW across the lake: an open lawn by a pavilion, playground, dock and boat ramp. The 218 number is the one Steele County gives for Jake Dickson, so it appears to be the same operator's tent/overflow area. 2019-2020 reviews: no formal lots, no hookups, honor box $10 tent / $15 RV; 2023 review: no fire pits, no hot water. Those reviews predate 2024, so they cannot price anything; not a separate lead.

Golden Lake Shores (lead 27) is NOT the same place: separate HHS licence (GOLDEN LAKE SHORES LLC, owners Williams, 30 units) at 13652 11th St NE, the adjacent address on the same east-shore strip (Lots 1-7 Golden Shores Subdivision, 'Golden Lake entrance, yellow house and campground on the left'). Two next-door businesses; which RV cluster on the imagery belongs to which was not settled.
No DB entry within 5 km (nearest 6024 Hatton Park Board Campground, 15 km). allstays.com (429), rvinglife.com and onlyinyourstate.com (403) refused and were not retried; ndtourism never used.

Phone list (only if AWH wants it): 701-963-3011 / 218-779-4652 - does Golden Lake Acres sell RV sites by the night, at what rate, and how many of the 48 are nightly vs seasonal? Even a yes would still need a published rate or booking site to pass test 2.
